links.outcome: Readability of LLM vitiligo patient education responses (Flesch Reading Ease)
links.effect: Elevated reading difficulty across all models; DeepSeek-R1 lowest readability (mean Flesch Reading Ease 19.7), significantly lower than OpenAI o1 and Grok 3 (both p < 0.01).
links.quote: Readability assessments revealed elevated reading difficulty across all models, with DeepSeek-R1 exhibiting the lowest readability (mean Flesch Reading Ease score of 19.7; pairwise comparisons showed DeepSeek-R1 scores were significantly lower than those of OpenAI o1 and Grok 3, both p < 0.01), potentially reducing accessibility for diverse patient populations.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, comprehensibility, and readability of three LLMs (OpenAI o1, DeepSeek-R1, Grok 3) for vitiligo patient education questions without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
